story.fullStory:
Donovan's "Colors" — original release 1965. "Colours" is a song written and recorded by Scottish singer-songwriter Donovan for his second album, Fairytale.

Artist: Donovan · Title: Colors · Album: Mocedades Y Donovan - Colores · Year: 1965 · Genre: Pop · PlayCount: 1 · LastPlayed: 1756096890 · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1960's/Donovan - Colors.mp4.

"Colours" was released as a single in the United Kingdom on 28 May 1965 through Pye Records (Pye 7N 15866) and a few months later in the United States through Hickory Records (Hickory 45-1324).

The single was backed with "To Sing for You" on the UK release and "Josie" on the US release.
